recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散點圖（TCRαβ 對 CD3，活細胞閘門），非形態影像；主要藍色族群為 CD3 強陽性並表現 TCRαβ，顯示擴增的是 αβ 型 T 細胞，灰色族群為 CD3 陰性細胞。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot, TCRab-PE (x-axis) versus CD3-PC7 (y-axis), gated on [Live Cells]
Dominant blue population with bright CD3 (about 10^2) and TCR alpha/beta expression ranging from dim to about 10^1
Small red cluster with brighter CD3 and TCR alpha/beta at the upper right of the main population
Red and blue events with dimmer CD3 trailing downward at lower TCR alpha/beta intensity
Large grey CD3-negative, TCR alpha/beta-negative population representing non-T cells
describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of live cells displays TCR alpha/beta versus CD3 expression. The dominant CD3-positive population (blue) expresses surface TCR alpha/beta, although with a broad range of intensity that is somewhat dimmer than a small red CD3-bright, TCR alpha/beta-bright subset. CD3-negative events (grey) represent granulocytes, monocytes, B and NK cells. The findings indicate an expanded alpha/beta T-cell population, as expected in T-prolymphocytic leukemia, which is almost always of alpha/beta lineage.
